subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
outcomes: I can say the sounds ear and ure in words.
I can read and use our, your and their.

tf.s: Beard and hear have the sound ear.
tf.why: Yes! b-ear-d and h-ear both have ear.

tf.s: Picture and vulture end with ure.
tf.why: Well done! pict-ure and vult-ure end with ure.

tf.s: A vulture is a big bird.
tf.why: Yes, a vulture is a big bird that eats meat.

tf.s: A beard is hair on a man's head.
tf.why: A beard is hair on a man's face.

tf.s: Two children talk about their own picture. They say: This is their picture.
tf.why: When it is our own picture, we say This is our picture.

tf.s: The teacher gives you a picture. She says: This is your picture.
tf.why: Good! Your is for the person you talk to.
Yes! our, your and their are tricky words.

boxes.q: Two children say: ___ mixture is green.
boxes.why: We use our for me and my friends.

boxes.q: Talking about the other children: ___ picture is good.
Talking to a friend: Where is ___ bag?
boxes.why: Your is for the person you talk to.

boxes.q: Hair on a man's face is a …
boxes.why: A beard grows on a man's face.

boxes.q: A big bird that eats meat is a …
boxes.why: A vulture is a big bird that eats meat.

hunt.q: A big bird that eats meat

mcq.q: Which two words have the same ending sound?
mcq.why: hear and beard both have ear.

mcq.q: Which is a tricky word from the lesson?
mcq.why: our, your and their are the tricky words.

mcq.q: Complete the tongue twister: I can hear a vulture and I can see a ___ of a man with a beard.
mcq.why: I can see a picture of a man with a beard.

mcq.q: You and your friend made a poster. You say: This is ___ poster.
mcq.why: Our is for me and my friend.

mcq.q: You point to a group of children: ___ bags are red.
Which word fits? I can h___ a vulture.

mcq.why: picture has ure; the others have ear.
year has ear; the others have ure.

mcq.q: The teacher talks to you and your partner: This is ___ picture. Which word is right?
mcq.why: The teacher talks to you, so she says your.
